verses.1: For the leader; with stringed instruments. A psalm; a song.
verses.2: May God be gracious to us and bless us; may God's face shine upon us. Selah
verses.3: So shall your rule be known upon the earth, your saving power among all the nations.
verses.4: May the peoples praise you, God; may all the peoples praise you!
verses.5: May the nations be glad and shout for joy; for you govern the peoples justly, you guide the nations upon the earth. Selah
verses.6: May the peoples praise you, God; may all the peoples praise you!
verses.7: The earth has yielded its harvest; God, our God, blesses us.
verses.8: May God bless us still; that the ends of the earth may revere our God.

notes.text: May God be gracious to us: the people's petition echoes the blessing pronounced upon them by the priests. Cf Numbers 6:22-27.
